android.desc:
KlasterMe is an investment tracking and discussion app designed to give you a clear view of your finances in one place.

KlasterMe brings investors together. Share insights, post ideas, and join stock-related discussions to learn from the community and gain new perspectives.

Track the stocks you own, monitor your holdings, and understand portfolio performance without unnecessary complexity. View your complete net worth by organizing assets across stocks, mutual funds, bank balances, investments, and crypto, with a clear breakdown of where your money is allocated.

Measure long-term performance by tracking net worth growth and CAGR, and stay informed about important corporate actions such as dividends, bonus issues, and stock splits.

Whether you’re just starting out or investing for the long term, KlasterMe helps you stay organized, informed, and connected.

KlasterMe - Connecting Investors, Sharing Insights.
